title: One Last Call
content:
Sneha remained silent for several moments.

She couldn't understand how the person sitting before her could remain so calm after everything he had endured.

Finally, she looked at Siddu.

"Why didn't you do anything to Shreya?" she asked softly.

"You could have confronted her... or at least made her realize how much she had hurt you."

Siddu smiled faintly.

"My parents raised me differently."

"They taught me to respect women, no matter what."

"They taught me that hurting someone just because they hurt you never brings peace."

He looked toward the distant mountains.

"Shreya may have played with my emotions..."

"But if she truly loved Karthik..."

"Then forcing her to stay with me would have been wrong."

"Love isn't something that can be won through anger."

"If her heart had already chosen someone else..."

"I had no right to stand in the way of her happiness."

He let out a slow breath.

"She hurt me..."

"But I never wanted to hurt her in return."

Sneha quietly looked at him.

The more she listened...

The more she admired the man sitting beside her.

Even after experiencing betrayal...

He still chose kindness over revenge.

For the first time, she realized that Siddu's greatest strength wasn't his intelligence...

It was his heart.

After a brief silence, she asked,

"So..."

"What happened after that?"

Siddu smiled.

"I went back home."

"I told my father everything that had happened."

"He was happy that I had chosen to move forward instead of letting hatred consume me."

"Slowly..."

"I left Shreya behind."

"I packed my belongings..."

"With Kiran's help, I booked my ticket to Uttar Pradesh..."

"And I spent a few peaceful days with my parents before leaving."

He looked at Sneha and smiled.

"And then..."

"I met you."

"On that train."

"And that's where this story began."

Sneha smiled softly.

"So..."

"That's the end of Shreya's story?"

Siddu looked away.

A mysterious smile appeared on his face.

"Not quite."

"One last thing was still left."

Sneha blinked.

"What happened?"

Siddu took a deep breath.

"Everything seemed over."

"I believed I had finally left the past behind."

"But fate had one final surprise waiting for me."

"While I was on my way to Uttar Pradesh..."

"My phone suddenly rang."

"I looked at the screen..."

"And froze."

"It was Shreya."

"For a few seconds, I didn't know whether to answer or ignore it."

"But eventually..."

"I answered."

He closed his eyes for a moment as the memory returned.

"'Hello?'"

There was silence.

Then I heard a familiar voice.

"Siddu..."

"Is that really you?"

"Yes," I replied quietly.

"What happened?"

On the other end...

Shreya's voice trembled.

"I have only one last request."

"I want to meet you..."

"One last time."

"Please..."

"Don't refuse."

There was a sadness in her voice that I had never heard before.

For a long moment...

I remained silent.

Then...

I made my decision.

"I turned back."

"I went to Bangalore."

Sneha's eyes widened.

"So..."

"That's why you got off the train that day?"

Siddu nodded.

"Yes."

"I went straight to meet her."

He paused.

"When she saw me..."

She didn't say a single word.

"The moment she saw me..."

"She ran straight toward me."

"Before I could react..."

"She wrapped her arms around me and broke down into uncontrollable tears."
